body.purpose: 16px on phones for text and controls; 12 to 14px only inside the dense calendar grid.

heading.purpose: Sheet and page titles, 20px semibold, no uppercase eyebrow labels.

data.purpose: Geist Mono for room numbers, dates and times only.

shadows.name: primary-button
shadows.purpose: The one small shadow, under the primary button.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Sheets, the booking panel and floating bars.

motion.name: ease-arrive
motion.purpose: Arrivals: sheets, panels, day and month slides (260 to 360ms).

motion.name: ease-leave
motion.purpose: Exits, always faster than the arrival (160 to 200ms).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Colour and press feedback on buttons and bars.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one green action on a screen or sheet: Confirm Booking, Save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent, #047857); color: var(--accent-ink, #fafafa); font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #047857); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Button
components.description: Every other action: quiet, outlined, 44px tall on touch.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #deded5); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #261f1c); font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #ecece6); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #047857); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Button (on)
components.description: A calendar tool with its icon above a one word label. On Hold shown on, in its own amber.
components.css: .ds-tool { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; min-height: 48px; width: 64px; padding: 6px 4px; border: 1px solid #fbbf24; border-radius: 8px; background: #fef3c7; color: var(--ink, #261f1c); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool-icon { color: #d97706; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #047857); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Booking Bar
components.description: A stay on the calendar: its colour, the name, then dates in green and red chips and a status chip as space allows.
components.html: Ana RaoMon 12 Jun to Thu 15 Jun3 nights Confirmed
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 1px; width: 190px; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #5cba91; border-radius: 8px; background: #cdeedd; color: var(--ink, #261f1c); font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; } .ds-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-bar i { font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-in { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); color: var(--accent, #047857); } .ds-out { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); color: var(--danger, #b42318); } .ds-st { background: var(--accent-soft, #d8f0e6); color: var(--accent, #047857); } .ds-n { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Zoom Control
components.description: Minus, slider, plus and the percentage, one outlined group in the second toolbar row.
components.css: .ds-zoom { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #deded5); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-zoom button { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-zoom button:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #ecece6); } .ds-pct { min-width: 64px; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #6f655c); } .ds-zoom input { width: 112px; accent-color: var(--accent, #047857); }

narrative.overview:
A front desk tool, not a showcase. One person, often older, often on a phone, often mid-conversation with a guest. The
design language is **plain, large, and certain**: one green action per screen, everything else quiet, and every state
shown in words and shape as well as colour. Nothing decorative; the brand lives in the precise details (hold hatching,
room colours, the logo).
keyCharacteristics: One emerald action per screen, everything else quiet
Every state shown in words and shape as well as colour
Large touch targets and 16px type for older eyes and thumbs
Check-in green and check-out red carry the same meaning everywhere

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Emerald means "do this" or "this is chosen". No second accent, no second radius.

rules.name: The Stable Calendar Rule
rules.body: Opening a panel, swapping a banner for a strip, or changing a mode never resizes the calendar.

dos: Do show one clear next step, with a number, when a task has steps.
Do keep text short: a label, then at most one line of help.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour, a second radius, or Lucide icons (Phosphor only).
Don't use dashes in UI text.
